protocol.scope: Default scene and seed; optional sugar command changes the reward location through the ordinary UI. No pose/readout/reward injection. Settled neural target-selection and approach/avoid choose the goal; body routes, landing and grooming are supplied execution. Learning is reported only when an actual matched lesson moves weights; no learned-navigation or learned-avoidance claim.
